Subject: MedCo: compliance packaging + pricing ask

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the routing and residency options. We're trying to finalize a procurement recommendation this month and I need a consolidated price & credit ask that ties together audit logs, KMS/HSM seats, and EU residency.

High-level ask from my side: can Redwood provide a single-year offer that includes:
- Audit log retention at 5 years (exportable)
- Dedicated HSM seats (2) with KMS integration
- EU data residency for primary lanes (single-region)
- A bulk compliance credit to offset migration/validation work

Target: we have an internal budget target and procurement would like to see a price with a one-time implementation credit applied against year-one fees, and a demonstration of how the addons are itemized on the SOW. If you can send options (standard packaging vs. a bundled credit) and any constraints on SLAs or lead times for HSM, that would be helpful.

We'd like a short timeline: quote by Friday (09/10) if possible.

—Carolyn
Procurement, MedCo Health

Hi Carolyn — thanks for the clear ask. Attaching a consolidated quote (v2) and a security matrix for your SOC/audit team.

Quick summary of what I've put together:
- Option A (Modular): itemized line items for Audit Logs (per-TB retention tiers), KMS/HSM (2-seat subscription), EU residency (region add-on). No implementation credit.
- Option B (Consolidated Bundle): 12-month bundle that combines the three addons at a blended price with a one-time migration/validation credit applied in month 1.

Callouts/constraints:
- HSM lead time: provisioning for HSM seats can take 4–6 weeks after contract signature (depends on onboarding questionnaire completion).
- Audit log exportability: we can provide exportable CSVs + S3 ingests; extended retention adds a small storage charge (included in bundle pricing assumptions).

Ask from you: which of the two options you prefer for procurement and whether the credit should be applied as a one-time invoice credit (preferred) or as a monthly discount amortized across Q4.

Looping in Markus (sales lead) and Lauren (finance) to confirm the maximum concession window I can offer without an escalation.

Thanks — I'll hold for your preference and can update the quote.

Camila — quick internal note. I reviewed the price model you attached. Two recommendations before we send final back to MedCo:

1) Counter-offer credit structure: approve up to a 20% one-time implementation credit applied to the bundle (Option B). We should reserve deeper concession (up to 30%) only if they commit to a 12-month reserved capacity addendum or a 24-month billing term.

2) HSM/E2E SLA: commit to provisioning timeline of 6 weeks in the SOW, with a single-week penalty credit if we miss the date (capped). This reduces procurement friction but keeps exposure manageable.

3) Residency milestone: phase the EU residency cutover into two milestones (pilot region, then primary). Offer a small transition credit (equivalent to 10% of residency addon) upon pilot completion to help with validation costs.

Lauren — can you validate the 20% credit and confirm how that maps to Net New revenue impact and revenue recognition? We want the offer packaged as a single invoice credit on signing if finance is OK.

Markus
VP Sales | Redwood Inference

Thanks — reviewed. Finance is comfortable with the 20% one-time credit as long as:
- It's explicitly documented as an implementation/validation credit on the SOW (non-refundable, applied on first invoice).
- We include language that any additional custom work beyond the documented migration scope will be billed T&M.
- We add a clause that seats (HSM) require completion of the onboarding questionnaire and are billed from the provisioning date.

I'll approve the credit and the milestone wording. Camila, send the counteroffer email to Carolyn with Option B (bundle) priced at list minus 20% credit, include the HSM lead-time language and the residency milestone credit. Also attach the SOW draft and a DocuSign envelope link.
